verdict.rationale: A tax agency could plausibly publish a public API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only interactive login portals (eFile and Pay, the Business Tax Application shell behind authentication), a published XML schema package for bulk reemployment-tax data files, and batch-enrollment specs available only by email request. A file-format specification and gated batch specs are adjacent data-interchange features, not a documented public API an agent can call to drive the product, and the llms.txt and markdown-docs probes returned 404.
